about_the_game:
BEFORE YOU BUY

DON’T SCREAM TOGETHER is a very simple co-op jumpscare horror experience. There are no complex objectives, puzzles, story, or deep mechanics. If you want a more complex or traditional horror game, this is not that game.

WHAT YOU DO

You and your friends enter a huge, pitch black forest with camcorders in 1993. Your goal is simple: reach 8:00 AM without screaming or making a loud noise. As you wander through the forest, you search for batteries to keep your camcorders powered and look for symbols scattered throughout the area. Time only moves when you do, so you cannot stand still forever. The forest is filled with strange locations, hidden traps, and the occasional hunter.

Features

• Proximity chat

• 4-player online co-op (up to 12 in testing)

• Two modes: restart or return as the hunter

• Dynamic scares make every playthrough feel new

• 1990s found-footage style

• A short, silly horror experience with friends

1. Calibrate Your Microphone

Set it up in-game. It's not just tech setup; it defines your experience. A mere squeak or quiet gasp should be flagged as a scream, causing you to restart.

2. Mind Your Voice

You can talk freely using proximity chat, but keep it quiet and controlled. If anyone speaks too loudly, everyone pays the price.

3. Play Fair

You can try to bypass calibration and shout through scares, but it removes the point. The fun comes from trying to stay calm while your friends absolutely do not.
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti, 4GB or AMD Radeon RX 470, 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 17 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Microphone Required - Headset + SSD Highly Recommended
